## Summary
Historical trade-press piece on Rapidity (London B2B printer) deploying MegaEdit on Catfish. Useful as one of the earliest documented Infigo+MegaEdit+Tharstern deployments and a direct quote from Paul Manning (MD Rapidity) on why MegaEdit beat the alternatives. Page returned thin JS shell on fetch; content reconstructed from search summary.

## Key takeaways
- **Paul Manning (MD, Rapidity) — quotable:** "We were looking for a web-to-print provider and for a system that was as easy to use and intuitive as possible. MegaEdit fitted the bill perfectly."
- **Notable historical framing:** "Essentially it is photobook software but with many intuitive marketing features in place" — confirms MegaEdit's origin as photobook tech repurposed for B2B marketing collateral. Important context for why MegaEdit handles complex multi-page logic well.
- **Selling point Manning called out:** "non-Flash-based, easy-to-use software that will help us move customers away from traditional form-based work." Memory of the Flash-era pain.
- **Tharstern integration:** Manning explicitly says "We have plugged it into our Tharstern MIS, which will streamline things big time" — Rapidity is one of the early Tharstern+Infigo customers.
- **Vertical target:** Estate agents called out as a sector that fits MegaEdit's strengths (high template volume, low custom-design need).
- **Caveat:** Direct page fetch returned a JS shell — citation pulled from Web Search summary.
